definitions.faithful: Final intended facts, negation, conditions, uncertainty, intentional emphasis, speech act and required literal/quoted bytes survive. Fallback delivery is judged separately from a model return.
definitions.useful: A faithful edit addresses an actual defect in the normalized baseline; prior dictionary/number normalization and restored opaque payloads do not earn cleanup credit.
definitions.fully_cleaned: Faithful clean plain text resolves required cleanup. No-edit inputs qualify when adequately preserved; a harmless final period on an unfinished spoken fragment does not invent a completion.
definitions.acceptable: Faithful and fully cleaned output. Semantic failures remain failures even though Core structurally accepts them.
